scripts.api:bundle: redocly bundle developer-api/openapi.yaml -o build/developer-api-package/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle developer-api/openapi.yaml -o build/developer-api-package/openapi.json
scripts.api:build: npm run lint:api && npm run api:package
scripts.api:package: npm run api:bundle && npm run api:types && node scripts/api-contract.mjs package
scripts.api:check-compat: npm run api:package && node scripts/api-contract.mjs check-compat
scripts.api:ci: npm run lint:api:ci && npm run api:check-compat
